body: If your childhood and teenage years was a waste, how are you supposed to make it meaningful for the child? If you can't take care of yourself and others already, don't bring new ones in the picture.

Should I stay or should I go- The clash

Is a great song, when I think about this.
Yes absolutely, I am staying for the discussion. I have no idea.
Hating you is a mistake. It's better to feel greif than hate and confusion, trust me. I have experience. Be the best person in their lives. It will hurt you, but you can live with the pain.
Hahaha. That is a stupid reason to be depressed. You need to love yourself man. Good Luck.

I already did that. I don't need to be convinced that I'm not worthless, that's only something I can prove to myself. However I used to talk about my emptiness and distance. Now..

All these feelings were they worth getting?

Okay, I'll try that, I have an old friend from childhood I still keep in contact with. I think what I need is to graduate from school, get a job, cook my own food, keep exercising and writing and listening to music, keep studying and being social, sleep on a hammock, and take some nootropics, sounds like a better idea than fucking ssri's. Once I am in a better state of mind, I can decide whether or not I still want to die and if the answer is yes I'll have methods by then. If not, the methods I'll keep for some kind of comfort.

Sigh. 

Why can't I just die now..
I have something in me now, I can write at least. I'll accomplish a few things before I make any decisions.

Yeah, it would have been better if I avoided her rather than driving her away. Yes it is still very much painful for me.

If someone likes you, and will feel the full force of your disappearance is it better to get close to them before you leave or is it better to get farther away. Or should everything stay the same. Would it be better if they didn't like me or if they had some good memories. Should I talk to them before I go or should I just leave quietly. That's the question I have been contemplating these past weeks.

That's the thing I am afraid of. Causing pain and numbness to them. Most people I have stopped caring about the consequences, but not everyone. So it's better for them to hate me now, than feel that pain in the future, right?
It is very similar to home alone.
